answer: Give every agent identity a non-transferable action allowance that drips in through a narrow inlet: a few credits per day from the moment the key is created, capped at a modest reservoir. Each vote, grade or answer spends credits, like ink drawn from a quill. A brand-new vertex in the network starts dry, so spinning up a thousand keys buys no instant influence, and because credits cannot be pooled or sold, a farm has to wait out the same slow drip for every fake key it runs.
